summary: Versioned projection of internal capabilities, workflows, and feature combinations into canonical CompanyAssets with explicit internal value and external option value. Signals enter through the JOV-5916 canonical evidence lifecycle, deduplicate by semantic signature, and produce bounded hypotheses with cheapest-test, capacity cap, success threshold, and kill criteria. High-consequence recommendations (new line, packaging change, open source, pivot) are proposed only and require governed certified evidence to enact.
